At least two individuals were the '''parents''' of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Thana Vesh]] were members of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and they raised their daughter in wealth and privilege on the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. However, Thana had a volatile temper and took pleasure in destroying her surroundings and tormenting her [[Parent/Legends|parents]]; when she discovered she was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Thana experimented on her parents' [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]]. After the eighth [[Death/Legends|fatality]],<ref name="Codex" /> sometime after [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Thana's parents tried to suppress her [[Force power/Legends|power]]. However, Thana lashed out, killing her parents and causing an entire block of [[Kaas City]] to [[Fire/Legends|burn]] to the ground.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thana Vesh's parents were mentioned in the character's Codex entry in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
